question.text: If three elements $A, B, C$ crystalise in a cubic solid lattice with $B$ atoms at the cubic centres, $C$ atoms at the centre of edges and $A$ atoms at the corners, then formula of the compound is

solution.text:
Number of A atoms $=\frac{1}{8} \times 8=1$
Number of $C$ atoms $=\frac{1}{4} \times 12=3$
Number of B atom = 1
Hence $\mathrm{ABC}_3$
